newsitem.title: Austria: Belgian bus crashes in Tyrol, 26 students injured.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bus crashes in Tyrol, 26 students injured.

text.p: A bus carrying a Belgian group of tourism students crashed on Tuesday in the western Austrian state of Tyrol, injuring 26 of those aboard, some of them seriously, local police said.
The bus, carrying 32 students from a tourism school in Mechelen, careered off a road running between the villages of Zell am Ziller to Mittersill as it tried an evasive manoeuvre.
The students are aged between 18 and 22 years.
One student suffering critical injuries was transported by helicopter to a nearby hospital.
